label: Partner & Business Launch Readiness
businessMessage: ERN can connect visitor intent to useful travel actions only after a visitor chooses a place. Affiliate availability never changes Earth-window truth or editorial ranking.
cameraOwnerMessage: Camera owners can prepare a public source for ERN review. Rights, source truth, currentness, visual usefulness and playback are reviewed separately; publication is never automatic.
localPlaceMessage: Local places can be useful even when they are not famous. ERN supports reviewed discovery without paid ranking.
humanExternalActionsRemaining: Configure payout method before the first payout is due.
Generate new exact destination-level affiliate links only for a vetted small batch when needed.
Create/connect any official social accounts only with explicit owner action.
